from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class CompanyEquity(BaseModel):
    """One company's total owner's equity from a single financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="The company name as named in the report")
    equity_amount: float | None = Field(description="Total Owner's Equity amount in yuan")
    equity_currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency of the equity amount")
    reporting_period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period, e.g., '2024年第一季度'")
    quote: str | None = Field(description="A short excerpt from the document containing the equity figure")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    """Parsed entities from all financial reports in the collection."""
    company_equities: list[CompanyEquity]
